people.name: Abner
people.line: Saul's cousin and commander of his army

people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

translations.web: God do so to Abner, and more also, if, as Yahweh has sworn to David, I don’t do even so to him;
translations.bsb: May God punish Abner, and ever so severely, if I do not do for David what the LORD has sworn to him:
translations.kjv: So do God to Abner, and more also, except, as the LORD hath sworn to David, even so I do to him;
translations.asv: God do so to Abner, and more also, if, as Jehovah hath sworn to David, I do not even so to him;
